comparativo.chartOfAccountsEntriesThat: Chart of accounts entries that aren't overhead, since those already have their own tab, with a monthly reference cost. Here the company sees what's planned in the system, what isn't yet, and whether the plan is being met.
comparativo.theRestOfTheChart: The rest of the chart of accounts already has an estimate from the records.
comparativo.accountsComeFromTheChart: Accounts come from the chart of accounts, except overhead, which has its own tab.
comparativo.noEstimateInTheRecords: No estimate in the records points to this account. It's a candidate to become a record cost.
comparativo.ofAccountsAlreadyHaveA: {withEstimate} of {total} accounts already have a forecast in the system.
comparativo.thePlannedAmountAddsThe: The planned amount adds the asset costs by the period's volume (the meter readings, what was sold through build-ups, or the productivity on record), the financial cost on the amount received, and the material in the build-ups sold. Longer periods are more accurate: purchases don't happen in the same month as consumption. Depreciation doesn't appear here, because it has no matching financial entry.
comparativo.whichChartOfAccountsAccount: Which chart-of-accounts account the comparison uses for the planned amount that doesn't come from an asset. With no choice, the default account applies: Raw Material for the material and Credit Card Fee for the financial cost.
comparativo.financialCostPricingPercentageOn: Financial cost (pricing percentage on the amount received)

inicio.thisTabDoesnTHave: This tab doesn't have an approved reference screen yet.
inicio.youDonTHavePermission: You don't have permission to view the cost base.
inicio.buildsTheCompanySMonthly: Builds the company's monthly reference cost and feeds pricing.

despesasAdministrativas.accountsShowUpHereAs: Accounts show up here as soon as they have entries.
despesasAdministrativas.noAccountsMatchTheSelected: No accounts match the selected filters.
despesasAdministrativas.whatTheMonthlyReferenceCost: What the monthly reference cost is
despesasAdministrativas.valueUsedToBuildThe: Value used to build the company's cost base and serve as the basis for allocation by department and pricing.
despesasAdministrativas.staysInOverheadFollowsThe: {remainder} stays in overhead · follows the reference cost
despesasAdministrativas.canBeSplitAmongThe: , can be split among the production departments that use it, for example by the space each one takes up. The allocated share becomes the department's own cost; whatever is left stays in the overhead total.
despesasAdministrativas.whenTheReferenceCostChanges: When the reference cost changes with the month or with the account's criterion, each department's amount follows on its own; typing in reais only serves to set the percentage.

distribuicao.chooseHowMuchOfThe: Choose how much of the overhead cost each production department receives. Distributing is optional: under the pure cost method, the default is to leave overhead out of the departments' cost and cover it with sales results.
distribuicao.addYourCompanySDepartments: Add your company's departments to distribute the overhead cost.
distribuicao.allocatedByItemInOverhead: allocated by item in Overhead, which became the departments' own cost.
distribuicao.noOverheadCostIsBeing: No overhead cost is being distributed.
distribuicao.whateverIsnTDistributedStays: Whatever isn't distributed stays out of the departments' cost.
distribuicao.theDepartmentCostThatDoesn: The department cost that doesn't belong to a piece of equipment, from
distribuicao.simplifiedAssetsDirectEntriesAnd: (simplified assets, direct entries and the overhead received), is split among the detailed equipment. Each one adds its share to its own cost, and that is where the hourly cost and the unit cost of each setup come from.
distribuicao.thisDepartmentSEquipmentList: This department's equipment list changed after the last manual allocation. Check each one's percentage and save again.
distribuicao.thisEquipmentReceivesNothingUnder: . This equipment receives nothing under this criterion; if no time is entered in the department, the purchase value is used.
distribuicao.withinEachDepartmentTheCost: Within each department, the cost that doesn't belong to a piece of equipment is split among the detailed equipment: by purchase value (base rule), by run time, or by a percentage entered manually.
distribuicao.addEquipmentWithProductivityUnder: Add equipment with productivity under Assets to choose how the department cost is split among them.
distribuicao.onlyOnePieceOfEquipment: Only one piece of equipment: it receives the whole cost
distribuicao.theEquipmentListChangedSave: The equipment list changed: save again

maoDeObra.theHourlyCostComesFrom: The hourly cost comes from the department cost divided by the team members' workload hours. The margin shows the result of the price charged over that cost.
maoDeObra.addYourCompanySDepartments: Add your company's departments to price the labor hour.
maoDeObra.enterHowManyHoursEach: Enter how many hours each team member spends on the department's production.
maoDeObra.noActiveTeamMembersIn: No active team members in this department
maoDeObra.toEstimateThisDepartmentS: To estimate this department's hourly cost, at least one team member must be added.

patrimonios.whereTheDepreciationThatGoes: Where the depreciation that goes into the departments' cost comes from. Editing is done in the asset's record.
patrimonios.addMachinesFurnitureAndVehicles: Add machines, furniture and vehicles to track depreciation.

porSetor.howMuchEachDepartmentCosts: How much each department costs per month and where each amount came from. Open the row to see the team members, assets and entries that make up the number.
porSetor.addYourCompanySDepartments: Add your company's departments to track each one's cost.
porSetor.theDistributedOverheadAppearsIn: The distributed overhead appears in its own column, separate from the department's own cost.
porSetor.overheadIsnTIncludedIn: Overhead isn't included in the departments' cost: it must be covered by the combined sales results.
porSetor.doesNotUpdateOnIts: · does not update on its own
porSetor.noCostsEnteredForThis: No costs entered for this department.

resumo.seeWhereEachAmountComes: See where each amount comes from
resumo.setUpOverheadPayrollAnd: Set up overhead, payroll and assets to see the company's cost.
resumo.averagesCalculatedThroughTheAmount: Averages calculated through {referenceMonth}. The amount includes depreciation, which is a management cost and doesn't come out of cash.
resumo.underThePureCostMethod: Under the pure cost method, overhead stays out of the production departments' cost and is covered by sales results.
resumo.ofOverheadIsDistributedAmong: {distributedCost} of overhead is distributed among the production departments.
resumo.noOverheadCostIsBeing: No overhead cost is being distributed among the departments.
